title: The Future of Probability: Guessing About Now

sections.title: What you already know
sections.content: You know *estará* for a guess about the present from B1 Unit 22: the future tense can express a guess about the present. *Estará en casa* means "He is probably at home". When you talk about writers read all over the world, you often cannot give exact figures, so you guess.

sections.title: Guessing with the future
rows: Habrá alguien comprando un libro de Borges.
*habrá* + gerund: someone is probably buying one now
Estará leyendo Rayuela en un café.
*estará* + gerund: he is probably reading it now

items.spanish: En una librería de la calle Corrientes habrá alguien comprando un libro de Borges.
items.english: In a bookshop on Corrientes Street, someone is probably buying a book by Borges.

items.spanish: No hay cifras exactas, pero serán millones de lectores.
items.english: There are no exact figures, but they are probably millions of readers.

items.spanish: En este momento alguien estará leyendo Rayuela en un café.
items.english: Right now someone is probably reading Rayuela in a café.

items.spanish: Ficciones tendrá lectores en muchos países.
items.english: Ficciones probably has readers in many countries.

sections.content: The future of probability is about the present, not about tomorrow: *estará leyendo* means "is probably reading now".
